decisions.statement: Treat V4 as a self-contained paper and matrix-spec campaign rather than open-ended engine ideation.
Preserve OpenAI as the primary family, with Anthropic and OpenRouter as the wave-1 control panel; Gemini and Grok are deferred.
Carry forward the geometry-first pilot thesis and avoid collapsing V4 into agreement-only or accuracy-only framing.
R01 established the candidate matrix shape and recommended a smaller shared-protocol design rather than a rigid full target grid.
R02 pruned the headline bundle to Gilardi plus Zheng, moved Ziems to appendix/follow-on status, and initially locked OpenRouter as a wave-1 provider-surface control.
R03 packaged the final matrix memo and implementation-facing study spec, satisfying the workspace terminal objective.
R04 reopened the campaign only for the provider-surface question and replaced the OpenRouter placeholder with a Qwen-centered Chinese open-weight lane.
R05 repackaged the final matrix and re-closed the campaign with appendix/watchlist lanes for DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, and Mercury.
